name: Air Fryer Cheeseburger Beef Quesadillas with Tomato Salad

components.name: Cheeseburger Quesadillas

ingredients.name: Oil spray, measured equivalent for basket

steps: Divide 600 g raw minced beef into eight equal portions; season with salt and black pepper. Make a very thin even beef layer across one side of each tortilla.
Preheat the air fryer to 180 C. Air fry each mince-topped tortilla until the mince is fully cooked; check the centre of the ground beef reaches 71 C. Cook in batches.
Scatter cheese evenly across the cooked-beef halves; briefly return to air fryer until melted. Fold tortillas over the filling and crisp for approximately 2-3 additional minutes.
Pack two quesadillas per serving, with salad and burger sauce in separate containers. Reheat quesadillas in the air fryer for best texture; avoid freezing salad.

components.name: Burger Sauce & Tomato Salad
steps: Mix yogurt, ketchup, mustard and chopped gherkins as a separate burger-style sauce.
Chop and combine tomatoes, lettuce and onion. Toss with lemon juice only when serving.

notes: Draft — needs Mirna review: not kitchen-tested yet; macros and cooked yields are estimates.
Adaptation of M&S cheeseburger quesadillas; exact batch weights adjusted for four full lunch portions. Beef must be cooked through before consuming.
Planning: Main dish is air-fryer based; one or two quesadillas per batch depending on fryer. Fresh vegetables stay separate.
Freezer: cooked beef quesadillas freeze, but tortilla softens; sauce and salad fresh
Dietary: Wheat, milk, mustard. No bacon/pork in UNHANGRY version.
Keeps 3–4 days in the fridge (≤4°C); refrigerate within 2 hours (1 hour above 32°C) in shallow containers, freeze portions for later in the week, and reheat to at least 74°C.
